The '''''Bremarc''''' was a [[rocket cruiser]] operated by the [[Exocron Airfleet]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], it defended the [[Devisors]]' [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generator from attack by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. The ''Bremarc'' failed in its assignment, as the X-wings were able to destroy the generator, thereby freeing the corvette ''[[FarStar]]''.
